note: Paired, repeated, exploratory and before/after observations are correlated. Map A/B only changed the name because cells were serialized before the edits; excluded from adoption. Catalog seed is a label; damageSeed changes combat variance. CPU times ran concurrently and are diagnostic only. No overall fairness or win-rate guarantee.

Transport isolates moved unloading on legacy movement. Baseline CPU means old heuristics using the current legal forecasts. Weather has an independent fixed stream. Undecided games are neither wins nor draws.
